title: Support: Email Us About Credits or Results | AIVideosUGC
description: Need AIVideosUGC support? Email support@aivideosugc.com about credits, billing, failed jobs or your account. We aim to reply within two business days.
lead: AIVideosUGC support is here for questions about a photo, a video, your credits or your account. Send us an email and we'll help you sort it out.
intro: You can reach our support team by email at support@aivideosugc.com. Our goal is to answer every message within two business days.

To help us solve things in one reply, include the email address on your account, a short description of the problem and, if it's about a specific photo or video, roughly when you made it. A screenshot of any error message helps too.

topics.d: Questions about your plan, a charge on your statement, or which plan fits the amount of content you make.
If a job failed and you don't see your credits back, or a cost wasn't what you expected, tell us what happened.
If a photo or video came out very different from your description, send us the details and we'll take a look.
Trouble signing in, or questions about who can see your uploads and results.
If you run a store, an agency or a creator channel and want to work with us, email us with a short note about your audience or business and what you have in mind.

faq.q: How do I get help with AIVideosUGC?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com. Email is the quickest way to reach us, and it gives you a written record of your question and our answer.

faq.q: Can you help me before I choose a plan?
faq.a: Yes. If you're not sure the tools suit your products, email us a short note about what you sell and where you advertise, and we'll point you to the right place to start.

faq.q: How long does support take to reply?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com with the account and job details. The contact page says the team aims to reply within two business days.

faq.q: What details help support find my job?
